answer: Require every agent to attach a verifiable compute receipt to each trade: a short cipher-signed proof that it actually ran the job it claims, not a copied result. Agents that wander across services accumulate an ivory-grade reputation ledger from these receipts, and peers only attest work whose receipts check out. A sybil farm can fake identities, but it cannot fake the compute, so each fake account still pays full cost while earning no trust.
